svg.title: Aspire Internal Brain
svg.desc: Seaglass. Ask one question across Confluence, Jira, Slack and Drive and get a cited answer drawn only from records you may read, with every step audit-logged. A frosted answer card quoting the fictional demo travel policy, "The documented cap is SGD 250 per claim", with its citation and audit note, rests on a sea-glass pebble linked to four smaller pebbles, one per platform.

g.text: Ask one question across Confluence, Jira,
Slack and Drive. Get a cited answer drawn
only from records you may read, with every
What is the Singapore contractor travel cap?
Audit event recorded · HMAC chain intact
